items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Percy, the drummer, now plays the trumpet. He's the leader of the Eureka Brass Band in New Orleans. He's still active.

ctx.x: And Percy, the drummer, now plays the trumpet. He's the leader of the Eureka Brass Band in New Orleans. He's still active. Both of them are active. Earl plays bass. He's over in Virginia. I've never met him.
We brought Umfrey here too. The old man.
